run_collective_comm_bench: run the commsCollBench to benchmark collective operations like all_reduce across PyTorch distributed ranks
run_pt2pt_bench: run point-to-point latency and bandwidth tests using send and recv between specified source and destination ranks
run_comms_compute_bench: run the comms-compute mode benchmark to measure overlapping collective communication with GEMM or embedding lookup kernels
run_quant_coll_bench: run quantized collective communication benchmark with sub-32-bit precision and measure quantization and dequantization overhead
run_multi_comm_group_bench: run benchmark across multiple communicator groups using genMultiCommGroups to split ranks into separate process groups
